statement: N-0071 follow-up to D-0057 (domain rule, Warren's call; not built). Question: when an open line's strict shipped twin has shipped less than the open quantity, should totals still skip the whole open line? Evidence (cip read-only, N0071_DISCOVERY.md): 552 strict pairs; 471 open = shipped, 71 open < shipped, 10 open > shipped (904 open units). In all 552 pairs a twin has the same order_line. Options: (a) keep as built (D-0057): skip the whole open line on key match; may under-count up to 904 units still open on those 10 lines; (b) count only the open quantity above the shipped twin total (open minus shipped, floor 0); needs a per-key sum and changes every reader on the shared helper at once; (c) keep (a) and list the 10 lines to Warren for a manual check. Assumptions: the Unship sheet row is a stale snapshot of the order line, not a separate remainder line. Impact: at most 904 units across 10 lines today; zero effect on the other 542. Reversibility: high, read-side only, no fact rewrite in any option. Resolving step: Warren reviews the 10 lines against the OEM order report. Built today: (a), as accepted.
